set.body: ViewerModel layer order and each layer's Colorizer are fixed at model construction; there is no ViewerAction to reorder layers or replace a colorizer/colormap. Neuropublish rebuilds the whole ViewerModel (and controller) on reorder or colormap change, carrying ViewerState across (WorkspaceStore.rebuild). Add ViewerAction.ReorderLayers(ids) and ViewerAction.SetColorizer(layer, colorizer) (or a model-level withLayers) reduced without discarding caches for untouched layers. Acceptance: reducer laws (order preserved for ids not mentioned; unknown id rejected); raster cache hit for untouched layers after reorder.
set.title: Typed reorder and colorizer-replacement actions for image-view
